data.title: The *team lead*
data.subtitle: Follow-ups in Outlook: Claude drafts, you press send.

blocks.text: Runs meetings and owns the follow-ups.
Turn meeting notes into a follow-up email and the next invite.

items: Sign in with your Claude account

blocks.text: Draft a follow-up email: decisions, actions with owners and dates, open questions. Under 200 words. Then draft an invite for a 30-minute follow-up next week.

items: An email draft in Outlook's compose form
Both wait for you to click **send**
